```
module school.grading
  purpose: Turn numeric scores from 0 to 100 into letter grades and count how many students earned each grade.

public type Grade is one of
  purpose: A letter grade from GradeA (best) to GradeF (failing).
  GradeA
  GradeB
  GradeC
  GradeD
  GradeF
  can Equal
  can ToText
end

public type GradeError is one of
  purpose: The reason a score could not be graded.
  OutOfRange(score: Integer)
  can ToText
end

public type GradeCounts
  purpose: The number of students who earned each letter grade.
  has grade_a: Integer
  has grade_b: Integer
  has grade_c: Integer
  has grade_d: Integer
  has grade_f: Integer
  can Equal
  can ToText
end

public function letter_grade(score: Integer)
  returns Grade
  or fails with GradeError
  purpose: Convert one score from 0 to 100 into a letter grade using the 90/80/70/60 cut-offs.
  tags: grading
  example: letter_grade(95) is GradeA
  example: letter_grade(90) is GradeA
  example: letter_grade(89) is GradeB
  example: letter_grade(75) is GradeC
  example: letter_grade(60) is GradeD
  example: letter_grade(59) is GradeF

  if score is less than 0 or score is greater than 100 then
    fail with OutOfRange(score: score)
  end
  if score is at least 90 then
    return GradeA
  otherwise if score is at least 80 then
    return GradeB
  otherwise if score is at least 70 then
    return GradeC
  otherwise if score is at least 60 then
    return GradeD
  otherwise
    return GradeF
  end
end

public function grade_all(scores: List of Integer)
  returns List of Grade
  or fails with GradeError
  purpose: Convert every score in the list into a letter grade, keeping the order; fails if any score is outside 0 to 100.
  tags: grading
  see also: letter_grade
  example: grade_all([95, 85, 40]) is [GradeA, GradeB, GradeF]

  let grades be
    for each score in scores
    collect letter_grade(score) otherwise fail
  return grades
end

public function count_grades(scores: List of Integer)
  returns GradeCounts
  or fails with GradeError
  purpose: Count how many students received each letter grade; fails if any score is outside 0 to 100.
  tags: grading, statistics
  see also: grade_all
  example: count_grades([95, 91, 85, 72, 65, 10]) is GradeCounts(grade_a: 2, grade_b: 1, grade_c: 1, grade_d: 1, grade_f: 1)

  let grades be grade_all(scores) otherwise fail
  let total_a be for each grade in grades where grade is GradeA count
  let total_b be for each grade in grades where grade is GradeB count
  let total_c be for each grade in grades where grade is GradeC count
  let total_d be for each grade in grades where grade is GradeD count
  let total_f be for each grade in grades where grade is GradeF count
  return GradeCounts(grade_a: total_a, grade_b: total_b, grade_c: total_c, grade_d: total_d, grade_f: total_f)
end

test "cut-offs are inclusive"
  check letter_grade(90) otherwise crash with "unexpected failure" is GradeA
  check letter_grade(80) otherwise crash with "unexpected failure" is GradeB
  check letter_grade(70) otherwise crash with "unexpected failure" is GradeC
  check letter_grade(60) otherwise crash with "unexpected failure" is GradeD
  check letter_grade(59) otherwise crash with "unexpected failure" is GradeF
end

test "grades are counted per letter"
  let counts be count_grades([100, 95, 85, 75, 65, 0]) otherwise crash with "unexpected failure"
  check counts.grade_a is 2
  check counts.grade_f is 1
end
```

```
module grading.letters
  purpose: Turn numeric scores from 0 to 100 into letter grades and count how many students earned each grade.

public function letter_grade(score: Integer)
  returns Text
  purpose: Convert one score into a letter grade using the 90/80/70/60 cut-offs.
  tags: grading
  example: letter_grade(95) is "A"
  example: letter_grade(90) is "A"
  example: letter_grade(89) is "B"
  example: letter_grade(75) is "C"
  example: letter_grade(60) is "D"
  example: letter_grade(59) is "F"

  if score is at least 90 then
    return "A"
  otherwise if score is at least 80 then
    return "B"
  otherwise if score is at least 70 then
    return "C"
  otherwise if score is at least 60 then
    return "D"
  otherwise
    return "F"
  end
end

public function letter_grades(scores: List of Integer)
  returns List of Text
  purpose: Convert every score in a list into its letter grade, keeping the original order.
  tags: grading
  see also: letter_grade
  example: letter_grades([95, 85, 42]) is ["A", "B", "F"]

  return for each score in scores collect letter_grade(score)
end

public function count_grades(scores: List of Integer)
  returns Map of Text to Integer
  purpose: Count how many students received each letter grade; every grade from A to F is present, even with a count of zero.
  tags: grading
  see also: letter_grade
  example: count_grades([95, 91, 72]) is {"A": 2, "B": 0, "C": 1, "D": 0, "F": 0}

  let mutable counts be {"A": 0, "B": 0, "C": 0, "D": 0, "F": 0}
  for each score in scores
    let grade be letter_grade(score)
    let current be counts.get(grade) otherwise 0
    set counts to counts.set(key: grade, value: current + 1)
  end
  return counts
end

test "cut-offs map to the right letters"
  check letter_grade(100) is "A"
  check letter_grade(80) is "B"
  check letter_grade(70) is "C"
  check letter_grade(0) is "F"
end

test "grades are counted per letter"
  check count_grades([95, 85, 85, 10]).get("B") is 2
end
```

```
public type GradingError is one of

  purpose: How many students received each letter grade.
  has grade_a: Integer
  has grade_b: Integer
  has grade_c: Integer
  has grade_d: Integer
  has grade_f: Integer
  can Equal
end

public function grade_for(score: Integer)
  returns Grade
  or fails with GradingError
  purpose: Convert one score to a letter grade using the 90/80/70/60 cut-offs.
  tags: grading
  see also: grades_for
  example: grade_for(95) is GradeA
  example: grade_for(80) is GradeB
  example: grade_for(79) is GradeC
  example: grade_for(60) is GradeD
  example: grade_for(59) is GradeF

  if score is less than 0 or score is greater than 100 then
    fail with OutOfRange(score: score)
  end
  if score is at least 90 then
    return GradeA
  otherwise if score is at least 80 then
    return GradeB
  otherwise if score is at least 70 then
    return GradeC
  otherwise if score is at least 60 then
    return GradeD
  otherwise
    return GradeF
  end
end

public function grades_for(scores: List of Integer)
  returns List of Grade
  or fails with GradingError
  purpose: Convert every score in the list to a letter grade, keeping the order.
  tags: grading
  see also: grade_for
  example: grades_for([95, 72, 40]) is [GradeA, GradeC, GradeF]

  let mutable grades: List of Grade be []
  for each score in scores
    let grade be grade_for(score) otherwise fail
    set grades to grades.append(grade)
  end
  return grades
end

public function letter(self: Grade)
  returns Text
  purpose: The single-letter text for a grade, such as "A".
  tags: grading
  example: letter(GradeA) is "A"
  example: letter(GradeF) is "F"

  match self
    when GradeA then return "A"
    when GradeB then return "B"
    when GradeC then return "C"
    when GradeD then return "D"
    when GradeF then return "F"
  end
end

public function count_grades(scores: List of Integer)
  returns GradeCounts
  or fails with GradingError
  purpose: Count how many students received each letter grade.
  tags: grading, statistics
  see also: grades_for
  example: count_grades([95, 85, 85, 10]) is GradeCounts(grade_a: 1, grade_b: 2, grade_c: 0, grade_d: 0, grade_f: 1)

  let grades be grades_for(scores) otherwise fail
  let total_a be for each grade in grades where grade is GradeA count
  let total_b be for each grade in grades where grade is GradeB count
  let total_c be for each grade in grades where grade is GradeC count
  let total_d be for each grade in grades where grade is GradeD count
  let total_f be for each grade in grades where grade is GradeF count
  return GradeCounts(grade_a: total_a, grade_b: total_b, grade_c: total_c, grade_d: total_d, grade_f: total_f)
end

test "cut-offs are inclusive"
  check grade_for(90) is GradeA
  check grade_for(89) is GradeB
  check grade_for(70) is GradeC
end

test "counts are tallied per grade"
  check count_grades([100, 91, 50]) is GradeCounts(grade_a: 2, grade_b: 0, grade_c: 0, grade_d: 0, grade_f: 1)
end
```

```
  purpose: Convert one score to a letter using the 90/80/70/60 cut-offs.

  example: letter_grade(90) is A
  example: letter_grade(89) is B

  example: letter_grade(60) is D
  example: letter_grade(59) is F

  if score is less than 0 or score is greater than 100 then
    fail with OutOfRange(score: score)
  end
  if score is at least 90 then
    return A
  otherwise if score is at least 80 then
    return B
  otherwise if score is at least 70 then
    return C
  otherwise if score is at least 60 then
    return D
  otherwise
    return F
  end

public function grade_all(scores: List of Integer)
  returns List of Grade
  or fails with ScoreError
  purpose: Convert every score to a letter grade, keeping the original order.

  example: grade_all([95, 82, 40]) is [A, B, F]

  let mutable grades: List of Grade be []
  for each score in scores
    let grade be letter_grade(score) otherwise fail
    set grades to grades.append(grade)
  end
  return grades
end

public function count_grades(grades: List of Grade)
  returns GradeCounts
  purpose: Count how many students received each letter grade.
  tags: grading, statistics
  see also: count_scores
  example: count_grades([A, A, B, F]) is GradeCounts(a_count: 2, b_count: 1, c_count: 0, d_count: 0, f_count: 1)

  let a_total be for each grade in grades where grade is A count
  let b_total be for each grade in grades where grade is B count
  let c_total be for each grade in grades where grade is C count
  let d_total be for each grade in grades where grade is D count

public function count_scores(scores: List of Integer)
  returns GradeCounts
  or fails with ScoreError
  purpose: Grade a list of scores and count how many students got each grade.
  tags: grading, statistics
  see also: grade_all, count_grades
  example: count_scores([95, 91, 72]) is GradeCounts(a_count: 2, b_count: 0, c_count: 1, d_count: 0, f_count: 0)
```
